items.source: Note: this default behavior for interpreting the return value from an @SubscribeMapping method can be overridden through use of the SendTo or SendToUser annotations in which case a message is prepared and sent to the broker instead.
items.translation: 注意： 可以通过使用 SendTo 或 SendToUser 注解来覆盖对 @SubscribeMapping 方法返回值进行解释的此默认行为，在这种情况下将准备消息并发送到代理。

items.source: The value returned from the method is converted and turned into a Message that is then enriched with the sessionId, subscriptionId, and destination of the input message.
items.translation: 方法返回的值被转换并转换为一个 `Message`，该消息随后会被丰富上输入消息的 sessionId、subscriptionId 和 destination。
